caption_L1: This bar chart is labeled Emerging Markets Bond Index (EMBI) spread in selected Latin American countries in 2020. The x-axis plots January 31 using linear scale from 0.0 to 1.5 while the y-axis shows Country along categorical scale starting at Argentina and ending at Venezuela.
caption_L2L3: Venezuela has largest EMBI on January 31st.  Chile, Panama and Peru have the smallest EMBI on the same date.  Apart from Argentina and Ecuador all the rest have a similar EMBI.
